name: pink_noise_murmur_source
mechanism: The child replaces white-noise excitation for the holosystolic murmur with frequency-domain-shaped pink noise, creating a physiological 1/f spectral roll-off that reduces excessive high-frequency energy.
code_snippet: generate_pink_noise() applies 1/sqrt(f) magnitude shaping, and generate_murmur() uses the shaped noise with a 350 Hz iirpeak resonance.

name: sos_butterworth_filtering
mechanism: Replacing high-order Butterworth transfer-function filtfilt with second-order-section sosfiltfilt avoids numerical distortion at low normalized cutoffs and preserves the intended ventricular septal defect murmur spectrum.
code_snippet: sos_hp = signal.butter(4, low / nyq, btype='high', output='sos'); murmur = signal.sosfiltfilt(sos_hp, colored)
